topic: AI Concepts for Developers and Technology Professionals
course_description: Microsoft Learn's 'AI concepts for developers and technology professionals' path: seven short modules covering core AI concepts and terminology across generative AI and agents, natural language processing, speech, computer vision, information extraction, and retrieval-augmented generation. All modules are free on Microsoft Learn and need no account.
audience: Developers and technology professionals starting with AI
intended_learning_outcome: Explain core AI concepts and terminology across generative AI and agents, natural language processing, speech, computer vision, information extraction, and retrieval-augmented generation, and use them to reason about AI workloads and plan AI solutions
